thread:
Ava: quick one — attached are two mocks for the first-run helper: a persistent bottom strip (compact, non-modal) vs a floating stepper modal. need UX + accessibility + eng takes. thoughts?
Samir: saw the mocks. persistent strip feels lighter, keeps context. floating modal is clearer for linear flows tho. want to see data on drop-off points before we pick.
Jae: impl note — strip is easier (single component, sticky). modal needs focus trap, portal handling, and trap for screen readers. modal might add 2–3 days work for keyboard/a11y polish.
Lena: from analytics POV, if we use strip we should include an unobtrusive progress metric (e.g., "2 of 4 steps") and a CTA per step. also add an event for "skip onboarding" and capture which sample project they pick.
Samir: copy nit — instead of "Get started", try "Try a sample project" to reduce cognitive load. also CTA for "Skip for now" should be lower-contrast but keyboard reachable.
Jae: a11y nit: strip needs visible focus states for all interactive elements (2px outline + focus-visible). color contrast for the strip bg vs text currently fails WCAG for the secondary link. I'll attach quick color tokens.
Ava: good call. Samir — can you drop the microcopy variants here? Lena — can you add the funnel events we need? Jae — estimate for fixes if we go with modal vs strip?
Samir: copy variants:
- Primary: "Try a sample project"
- Secondary: "Explore templates"
- Skip: "Maybe later"
Also microcopy under the progress: "We’ll walk you through connecting your first model." small, muted.
Jae: estimates: strip base + a11y fixes — 1 day. modal full polish (focus trap, screenreader labels, animations disabled for prefers-reduced-motion) — 3 days.
Lena: events: onboarding.start, onboarding.step_completed (props: step_id, sample_id), onboarding.skipped, onboarding.completed. Also track CTA clicks and time-to-first-call. I'll wire up a quick dashboard tile for PMs.
Ava: consensus leaning toward strip given time. Action items: Samir finalize copy, Jae implement strip + a11y tokens, Lena add analytics. I'll open a PR checklist for rollout and a canary flag.
deploy-bot: deploy 1748000050: feature/first-run-strip staged to staging — smoke tests passed.
Lena: accessibility QA reminder — please run the automated axe check and add at least one voiceover/screenreader pass in staging. I'll schedule a quick session tomorrow 10am.
Ava: thanks everyone — I'll update the product spec with the decisions and assign tasks. :thumbsup:
